name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart and press a dumbbell straight overhead in one hand with your palm facing inward.
Keep your upper arm close to your ear and brace your core so your rib cage stays down.
Bend your elbow to lower the dumbbell behind your head until you feel a full stretch in your triceps.
Extend your elbow to press the dumbbell back overhead, and switch arms after finishing one side.
tips: Keep your elbow pointed forward and upward rather than letting it flare far out to the side.
Avoid arching your lower back or jutting your head forward as the dumbbell lowers.
